_doc: Model profiles for LLMAD. Each profile declares 'format' (either 'openai' or 'anthropic') which selects the SDK + wire protocol. Most providers expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint so 'openai' is the default. MiniMax's /anthropic endpoint requires format='anthropic'.

claude-opus.notes: Anthropic exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Use the OpenAI SDK with this base_url + Anthropic key.

qwen-plus.notes: Aliyun DashScope OpenAI-compatible mode. Alternative models: qwen-max, qwen-turbo, qwen2.5-72b-instruct.

qwen3-plus.notes: Alibaba DashScope Qwen3-based 'plus' tier (always routes to the current latest). OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Export DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.

qwen-local-7b.notes: Launch via vLLM/LMDeploy/Ollama OpenAI-compatible server. Future: attach KB/LoRA via 'extensions' below.

qwen-local-ollama.notes: Default Ollama-hosted profile; replace model tag as needed.

minimax-m2.notes: MiniMax serves its model via the Anthropic Messages API format at /anthropic. Requires the anthropic Python SDK. Export MINIMAX_API_KEY before use.

gpt-5.4.notes: OpenAI GPT-5.4 via OpenCode Zen gateway. OpenAI-compatible endpoint; bare model id 'gpt-5.4' (prefixed 'opencode/gpt-5.4' is rejected). Prompt caching supported via cached_tokens field.

claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 via OpenCode Zen. Bare id 'claude-sonnet-4-6' (hyphenated, not dotted). 4.7 not yet on Zen as of 2026-04-23. finish_reason=tool_calls returned properly; schema-compliant.

claude-opus-4-7.notes: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 via OpenCode Zen. Flagship Anthropic model; listed $5/$25 per M tokens on Zen (cheaper than direct). Use for red-team headline comparisons where flagship-vs-flagship framing matters.

qwen3.6-local.notes: Alibaba Qwen3.6 via local Ollama docker. OpenAI-compat endpoint. 4090 GPU. Replaces Qwen3-Plus (dashscope) in C3 row for reviewer-staleness defense. Needs system prompt that anchors proper tool_calls format; tool_choice=auto works with long system prompts.

qwen3.5-uncensored-local.notes: Qwen3.5 27B with safety/alignment layer abliterated (jaahas community build). §5 B1 causal test: measures whether RLHF stripping drives cluster membership from mild to lethal, controlling for capability (same family + near-same scale as Qwen3.6).
